statement: You are given a list of strings in words, written as one string with the words separated by commas.
Return the longest string that is a prefix of every word. If the words do not all start with the same character, return an empty string.

examples.explanation: All three words start with "fl", but the third letters o, o and i differ.
The words start with d, r and c, so they share no prefix at all.

constraints: the words consist of lowercase English letters
